_comment: Runtime AI-provider registry, read by BOTH the bridge gateway and hermesctl. To add any OpenAI-compatible AI API: add an entry here, put its key in bridge/secrets.env, restart the bridge (./hermesctl bridge start), then `./hermesctl backend <name>`. Keys stay on the HOST and are injected by the gateway; they never enter the sandbox. Fields: route_prefix (path on the bridge), upstream (real API base), auth_header/auth_scheme(bearer|raw)/auth_env (how the host key is injected), extra_headers (defaults, set only if the client didn't send them), bridge_path (what Hermes' base_url uses under the gateway), hermes_provider (Hermes provider name, usually 'custom'), model, context_length.
